question: How do I configure PostHog analytics in my Fern Docs project?
ground_truth: To configure PostHog analytics in Fern Docs, you need to add a PostHog configuration to your docs.yml file with your API key. First, obtain your PostHog API Key from your project settings at https://us.posthog.com/settings/project. Then, in your docs.yml file, add the analytics configuration with your PostHog API key, which can be read from environment variables. You can also optionally specify a custom PostHog endpoint if you're using a self-hosted instance or a different region.

metadata.cited_context: To integrate PostHog, you'll need a Posthog API Key, and optionally, you can configure a custom Posthog host. You can find your PostHog API Key under your project settings. Then, in your `docs.yml` file, add your Posthog configuration: ```yaml analytics: posthog: api-key: ${{POSTHOG_API_KEY}} # reads your api key from environment variables # Optional endpoint: ${{POSTHOG_API_HOST}} # e.g. https://analytics.example.com or https://eu.i.posthog.com```
